question.problem: Find the value of $\arcsin (0.2)$ in degrees to the nearest degree.
question.worked_solution:
Using a calculator, we find 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(0.2) & =(11.536...)^{∘} \\  & ≈{12}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.
